sentences.en: There is one important fact of which you are unaware.
sentences.zh: 有一个重要的事实你不知道。

sentences.en: Sami was completely unaware of the insatiable greed driving Layla.
sentences.zh: 萨米完全不知道莱拉那无止境的贪婪。

sentences.en: He was unaware of the enormity of the offense.
sentences.zh: 他并不知道这行为有多么严重。

senses.zh: 不知道的，无意的；未察觉到的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：un（不）+aware（意识到的）→未意识到的
